description.zh: ? 一句话：按文档讲的是什么来找，不用记得原词。用你选的模型（“本地模型”插件或 Ollama，都在本机、不上传；或云服务的密钥）
description.en: ? a sentence: finds documents by what they are about, not by their words. Uses the model you pick (the Local models plugin or Ollama, on this PC with nothing uploaded; or a cloud service's key)

notes.zh: Win顺 更新后还在核对文件时，不再把已经建好的索引藏起来，也不再丢掉还没核对到的文件（#458）；在 Windows 10 上闲着也会归还内存，系统内存紧张时先不归还（#478、#471）。权限不变。
notes.en: While WinShun is still checking its files after an update, the index already built is no longer hidden and the files not checked yet are no longer dropped (#458); idle memory is given back on Windows 10 too, and kept while Windows is short of it (#478, #471). Permissions unchanged.
